title.narrative: EU4MOLDOVA: Clean Water for Cahul

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to contribute to improved living conditions of the population households in the region of Cahul through a broader access to quality water supply and to sanitation and therefore the minimisation of health risks, and also targeting the local public administration authorities (Municipality of Cahul, Rayon Cahul), Apa Canal Cahul, RDA South, civil society organisations to improved environmental protection and smarter use of natural resources.
